jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: Vestwell is the financial technology company powering the new savings economy. The New York City-based fintech platform redefines how people save for the critical aspects of life across retirement, education, and healthcare savings needs. Today, Vestwell enables over 790,000 businesses and more than 2.75 million active savers, with over $57 billion in assets saved across all 50 United States. Vestwell offers a range of products, including workplace-delivered retirement plans, employer-offered student loan repayment benefits, and various savings accounts for education, emergencies, and individuals with disabilities. Vestwell's platform serves a diverse clientele, including financial advisers, employers, third-party administrators, financial institutions, payroll providers, government agencies, and individual savers. To learn more, visit vestwell.com Who Are We Looking For? Vestwell is expanding and we’re keen to add an amazing Data Science role to our team. Someone who’s passionate about maths and algorithms to extract deep insights from large data sets, who will work primarily with our Cortex/AI solution, implementing ML and predictive analysis to help Vestwell see further into both the past and the future. We’re looking for someone who loves to solve problems and is driven to build great solutions. You will work across all our product lines - translating end-user needs into focused, actionable steps, that result in timely data products. You will help refine and execute our product vision, improving the requirement-intake process, and implementing new processes on a quarterly basis. Vestwell is a continuously evolving data engine at its heart. If you are someone who dives into whatever challenge is placed in front of you, you will find yourself involved in the planning and coordinating our overall AI-BI solutions, working with our Technical Director and his data engineering team to develop new research models and predictive analysis tooling. What Will You Be Doing? Understand high-level strategic initiatives and stakeholder requirements; identify opportunities; and translate inputs into buildable features with clear benefits Effectively communicate and share plans and rationales Partner with developers to break down product requirements into discrete tasks with clear functional requirements/acceptance criteria Provide constant and iterative feedback to the development team, including identifying bugs and assisting in resolution Complete functional testing and provide initial product sign-off when features are ready for end-user verification Develop processes and tools for tracking usage trends and allow data to inform future development plans Requirements The Necessities Graduate degree in data science or heavily-weighted category Ability to define and plan overall ML strategy with our Technical Director Ability to define and write algorithms 2-3+ years of Product Management experience Exceptional business and systems analysis skills Ability to work in a fast-paced, project-oriented environment to meet deadlines under tight time constraints Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment consisting of Product, Engineering, and QA resources Excellent communication skills, both in verbal and written formats Must have the ability to interface with internal stakeholders Ability to write/design python and/or R statistical programming The Extras Data warehousing experience (Snowflake or Databricks) Actuarial experience This role will be based in either the New York, Austin, King of Prussia, or Scottsdale office, and will be part of Vestwell's hybrid in-office operation. The expected base salary range for this position is $135K - $145K base. This position is eligible to participate in the Company Bonus Pool and is eligible to receive new hire equity in the Company. Please note that salary bands are based on NY and other similar metro areas and may differ based on where the role is ultimately hired. Full-Time Employee Benefits We’re an innovative, high-growth company with an exciting future ahead. At Vestwell, we prioritize employee wellbeing through comprehensive health benefits, generous time off, and a dedicated Employee Wellbeing Committee. Our hybrid work model offers flexibility while providing access to our collaborative offices in Midtown Manhattan, Austin, King of Prussia, and Scottsdale. And, of course, as a company focused on helping people save for the future, we offer a competitive 401(k) plan. Interview Process Our interview process starts the same for every candidate with 1-2 introductory conversations to learn more about your background, interests, and what you're looking for, while also giving you the opportunity to learn more about Vestwell and the team. From there, the process varies by role but typically includes a skills or experience-based assessment, such as a coding interview, portfolio review, or deeper discussion of your relevant experience. Successful candidates then move on to a virtual or in-person interview panel. Before extending an offer, we complete a reference check with a current or former manager and a peer. Throughout the process, we prioritize transparency, clear communication, and minimizing surprises. For your awareness you will only receive correspondence from recruiting@vestwell.com any other domain not ending in vestwell.com is not our Recruitment team. Vestwell’s Privacy Policy. Attention California residents: In the course of conducting our business and complying with federal, state, and local government regulations governing such matters as employment, tax, insurance, etc., we must collect Personal Information from you. Should you accept employment with Vestwell you may view our California Privacy Rights Act here: Vestwell’s California Privacy Rights Policy.

jobs.title: Data Engineer I
jobs.description: Overview Data Engineer I Department: TR IT Software Development Reports To: Data Engineer Manager FLSA Status: Exempt, Full-Time Build the Data. Power the Possibilities. Tire Rack is looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Data Engineer I to join our IT Software Development team! This is an exciting opportunity for an emerging data professional who is passionate about technology, problem-solving, and building scalable cloud-based data solutions. In this role, you'll work with modern technologies, including AWS, Databricks, Python, SQL, and Delta Lake, to develop and maintain data pipelines that support business intelligence, analytics, and data-driven decision-making across the organization. If you're eager to expand your technical skills, collaborate with experienced engineers, and make a meaningful impact through data, we want to hear from you! What You'll Do Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot ETL/ELT data pipelines using Databricks, PySpark, and SQL. Integrate data from various AWS sources, including S3, RDS, and APIs, into Delta Lake. Monitor data workflows, identify issues, and ensure reliable data processing. Write and optimize SQL queries to support data accessibility and performance. Assist with data governance, security, and access management using Unity Catalog. Utilize scripting languages and tools to integrate data from multiple sources. Collaborate with IT teams and business partners to support data warehousing and analytics initiatives. Follow cloud security standards and industry best practices. Stay current with emerging technologies and continuously develop technical expertise. Deliver accurate, reliable solutions while providing exceptional internal customer service. What We're Looking For 0-2 years of experience in data engineering, cloud development, or a related technical field. Foundational knowledge of Python and SQL. Familiarity with AWS services, including S3, IAM, EC2, and RDS. Exposure to Databricks, Apache Spark, or similar distributed data processing technologies preferred. Basic understanding of Delta Lake concepts, including tables, partitions, and ACID transactions. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn. A collaborative, self-motivated approach with the ability to work independently or as part of a team. Commitment to confidentiality, professionalism, and delivering quality results. Education & Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent work experience required. Relevant professional or cloud technology certifications are a plus. Work Schedule Days: Monday-Friday Hours: 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. Occasional evening or weekend hours may be required based on business needs. Start Your Career in Data Engineering with Tire Rack! At Tire Rack, you'll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, strengthen your technical expertise, and contribute to data solutions that help drive our business forward. Whether you're beginning your career in data engineering or looking to build on your existing technical foundation, this position offers an opportunity to learn, grow, and make an impact. Ready to turn data into meaningful solutions? Apply today and take the next step in your career with Tire Rack! #tireracklv

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer - Data Engineering
jobs.description: About Us Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services. Over 17,000 Organizations Worldwide Rely On SHI’s Concierge Approach To Help Them Solve What’s Next. But The Heartbeat Of SHI Is Our Employees – All 7,000 Of Them. If You Join Our Team, You’ll Enjoy Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S. Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities. Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family. World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours. Job Summary The SHI Services Solutions Engineer, Data Engineering is a key contributor within our Microsoft Data and AI practice. This role is responsible for designing, building, and delivering enterprise scale data engineering solutions using the Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric ecosystems. The Solutions Engineer works closely with Solution Engineers, Principal Engineers, Project Managers, and client stakeholders to implement secure, scalable, and compliant data platforms and pipelines that support analytics, reporting, and AI driven use cases. This role is hands on and delivery focused. Associate Solutions Engineers are expected to execute technical designs, own discrete data engineering workstreams, and contribute directly to successful client outcomes. Initial focus areas include state level public sector and regulated industry projects such as large scale data lakehouse implementations. This role reflects SHI’s commitment to delivering enterprise-grade data platforms that power analytics, insights, and AI at scale. Candidates who are motivated by hands-on engineering, Microsoft cloud innovation, and delivering high-impact solutions in regulated and complex environments will find this role both challenging and rewarding. This position is primarily remote, with a home office setup provided in accordance with company policy. Role Description Design, develop, and implement data ingestion, transformation, and integration pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric, and related Azure data services Build and optimize data lakehouse and warehouse solutions in Azure and Microsoft Fabric, ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and cost effectiveness Develop and maintain data models, ETL and ELT processes, and historical data versioning logic to support complex multi source datasets Configure and manage Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 environments, including data organization, lifecycle management, and archival strategies Implement data validation, cleansing, reconciliation, and quality controls to ensure trusted and auditable data platforms Collaborate with BI and analytics teams to prepare data for downstream reporting, analytics, and AI consumption Apply security best practices including encryption, identity based access control, and compliance with standards such as HIPAA, PII handling, and NIST 800 53 Support data governance practices including lineage, access patterns, and operational readiness Implement monitoring and operational reporting for pipelines and data platforms to support production support models Work with structured, semi structured, and unstructured data sources across cloud and on premises environments Participate in technical workshops, discovery sessions, and requirements gathering with clients and internal teams Translate business requirements into actionable technical solutions focused on client outcomes Produce high quality technical documentation including design artifacts, migration plans, and operational runbooks Contribute to reusable frameworks, templates, and engineering best practices within the Data and AI practice Participate in code reviews, testing, and quality assurance processes Follow modern engineering practices including source control, CI CD, and environment promotion strategies Support post implementation activities including troubleshooting, optimization, and client enablement Demonstrate ownership and accountability for assigned deliverables and proactively address delivery risks Behaviors and Competencies Presenting: Can design and deliver engaging presentations, adapting the content and style to suit the audience, context, and medium. Negotiation: Can proactively seek out negotiation opportunities, initiate discussions, and contribute to conflict resolution. Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information to diverse audiences and can facilitate effective communication between others. Detail-Oriented: Can manage complex tasks or projects, identifying errors or inconsistencies, and ensuring all details are addressed, necessary corrections are made, and quality is maintained. Organization: Can effectively coordinate multiple projects, delegate tasks where appropriate, and employ advanced organizational tools and methods. Follow-Up: Can proactively identify tasks that require follow-up, initiate necessary actions, and contribute to efficient workflow management. Relationship Building: Can proactively seek out opportunities to expand networks, initiate collaborations, and contribute to team cohesion. Documentation: Can develop comprehensive documentation standards, implement best practices, and ensure documentation supports operational efficiency. Results Orientation: Can set challenging goals for their team and lead them to achieve these goals, demonstrating a consistent track record of results. Skill Level Requirements Proven hands-on experience delivering modern data engineering solutions on Microsoft Azure and or Microsoft Fabric, including data ingestion, transformation, storage, and analytics enablement Strong engineering foundation across data pipelines, Lakehouse or warehouse architectures, and relational data platforms, with practical experience using services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Databricks, SQL Server, Azure SQL, ADLS Gen2, and Microsoft Fabric Experience designing and operating production data platforms, including data modeling, incremental processing, historical retention, monitoring, and operational support Solid understanding of data security, governance, and compliance concepts, including identity-based access, encryption, and working with sensitive or regulated data Experience working in consulting or project-based delivery environments, collaborating with engineers, project managers, and client stakeholders Familiarity with modern engineering practices such as source control, CI CD, testing, and environment promotion Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into practical technical solutions Certifications Microsoft Certified Azure Data Engineer Associate, required or expected within six to twelve months Preferred, Microsoft Certified Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate or Azure Solutions Architect Expert Other Requirements Ability to travel to SHI, Partner, and Customer Events Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative, cross-functional team. Commitment to continuous learning and professional development in Microsoft technologies and data visualization trends. Strong ethical standards and adherence to data privacy, governance, and security policies. Preferred Requirements Experience with dimensional and Lakehouse data modeling patterns Advanced proficiency in Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Microsoft Fabric. Experience operating and supporting production data platforms Experience implementing CI CD and infrastructure as code concepts Familiarity with Power BI operational reporting and monitoring templates Strong facilitation skills in client-facing and internal settings Experience delivering data platforms for public sector or regulated industry clients Experience supporting analytics, reporting, and AI-ready data workloads Experience contributing to reusable engineering frameworks, templates, or delivery standards Experience with Azure Databricks for advanced data engineering, transformation, and analytics. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: The Senior Data Engineer builds and operates cloud data pipelines, trusted data models, and reusable data products for analytics, risk, finance, product, and operational decisions. This hands-on role combines SQL, Python, dimensional modeling, and production ownership to improve platform reliability, govern data, and prepare datasets for emerging AI-powered products. Data Platform Engineering Design and operate scalable batch, streaming, and event-driven pipelines that integrate transactional systems, APIs, third-party providers, and enterprise sources. Develop reusable data products and dimensional and semantic models for business and analytical decision-making. Build and optimize ETL/ELT workflows with modern transformation and orchestration frameworks, improving efficiency, scalability, and maintainability. Strengthen data quality and observability through automated validation, reconciliation, freshness monitoring, anomaly detection, and proactive alerts. Create near-real-time capabilities for transaction monitoring, fraud and risk signals, and operational intelligence. Improve performance and cost efficiency while establishing scalable architecture patterns across warehouse and lakehouse environments. Build shared frameworks, self-service capabilities, and automated workflows that reduce repetitive engineering work and accelerate delivery. Apply CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, documentation, governance, and production ownership practices. Partner with Data Science and Machine Learning teams on reliable, AI-ready datasets and pipelines for intelligent products and applications. Lead complex initiatives independently, influence architecture, mentor engineers, and establish stronger engineering standards. Production Experience and Technical Judgment At least five years designing, building, and operating scalable data pipelines and enterprise data platforms in production. Advanced SQL and strong Python skills for maintainable, tested, production-quality code. Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, BigQuery, Redshift, or equivalent technologies. Strong modeling fundamentals, including fact and dimension tables, slowly changing dimensions, and reusable analytical models. Experience with ETL/ELT transformation frameworks such as dbt and orchestration platforms such as Airflow, Dagster, or equivalents. Experience with streaming, change data capture, or event-driven architectures using Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, Spark Structured Streaming, or comparable tools. Understanding of warehouses, lakes, lakehouses, and curated data products, along with experience in testing, monitoring, observability, metadata, lineage, and governance. Hands-on experience with a major cloud provider. Azure is preferred; AWS and GCP experience are equally transferable. Strong software engineering practices across Git, code reviews, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and production troubleshooting. Ability to make architectural decisions, assess tradeoffs, and improve scalability, performance, reliability, and cost. Experience translating requirements across Engineering, Analytics, Product, Risk, Finance, and Data Science into scalable solutions. Demonstrated mentoring experience and the ability to create reusable standards that help other engineers grow. Familiarity with AI-enabled engineering tools and an interest in data platforms for machine learning, intelligent applications, and AI workflows. A customer-focused, accountable, collaborative approach and a willingness to challenge existing ways of working. Remote Work and Compensation This is a remote-first opportunity for employees based in the United States. Working from the Manhattan office is optional. Base pay is USD $134,000–$175,000. Actual pay reflects industry benchmarks, role function and level, compensation strategy, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations. The total package may also include a bonus and/or equity awards, separately from medical, financial, and other benefits. Benefits and Application Information Flexible working practices and incentive programs. Unlimited paid time off, paid parental leave, and family support policies. Employer 401(k) matching. A learning and wellness subscription stipend. Employer-sponsored insurance for employees and dependents, including several options fully covered by the employer. An optional Union Square office with a casual dress code. The employer participates in E-Verify. The application asks about current state of residence, immigration sponsorship or work authorization support, AI experience, salary expectations, and acceptance of the candidate privacy statement. Greenhouse Talent Matching assists with reviewing applications for role-related skills and experience. Equal employment opportunity and accessible recruitment practices apply; candidates may request adjustments to the hiring process.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Data Engineer Location: Atlanta, GA Work Arrangement: Hybrid Job Type: Contract Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Data Engineer to design, build, and support scalable data and streaming solutions that transform enterprise data into trusted, governed datasets for business intelligence and advanced analytics. The Data Engineer will work across the full data engineering lifecycle—from gathering and clarifying requirements with business stakeholders and data modelers to designing lakehouse architectures, developing production pipelines, and supporting solutions in a cloud environment. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with Databricks, Delta Lake, Apache Spark, Kafka, AWS, and SQL, along with a strong engineering mindset focused on data quality, observability, scalability, and maintainability. Responsibilities Own the architecture, design, development, and delivery of scalable data engineering and streaming solutions. Partner with business stakeholders, data modelers, and technical teams to understand requirements and translate business needs into durable data solutions. Design and implement lakehouse architectures and production-grade data pipelines using Databricks and Delta Lake. Develop ingestion and transformation processes using Delta Live Tables (DLT), Apache Spark, Spark SQL, and PySpark. Build and support real-time and streaming data solutions using Kafka, including managed platforms such as Confluent Cloud. Leverage AWS services, including S3 and related integration patterns, to support enterprise data solutions. Develop complex and efficient SQL for data transformation, analysis, and integration. Apply strong software engineering practices to ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, reliable, and secure. Implement and maintain data quality, governance, monitoring, and observability practices. Troubleshoot production data pipelines and streaming processes and resolve performance and reliability issues. Collaborate across teams to define measurable outcomes and deliver data solutions that support BI and advanced analytics initiatives. Clearly communicate technical concepts, requirements, designs, and project status in both written and verbal formats. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Information Systems, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Information Systems, or a related field. Advanced, hands-on experience with Databricks and modern data engineering practices. Strong experience with Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, and Unity Catalog. Strong proficiency with Apache Spark, including Spark SQL and PySpark. Hands-on experience building streaming and event-driven data solutions using Kafka; Confluent Cloud experience is a plus. Strong experience with SQL and enterprise data transformation. Experience with AWS, particularly S3 and related data integration services/patterns. Experience designing and operating production-grade data pipelines and scalable analytics solutions. Strong understanding of data quality, governance, observability, and maintainability. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Confluent Cloud and managed Kafka environments. Experience with enterprise lakehouse architecture and modern data platforms. Experience supporting BI, advanced analytics, or data science initiatives. Strong understanding of data modeling and data architecture concepts. Experience with CI/CD, source control, automated testing, and other modern engineering practices.

jobs.title: Accounting Analytics & BI Engineer
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>As a member of our Finance Analytics and Business Intelligence team, you'll play an instrumental role in our company's mission of building safe and beneficial AI by establishing the analytics engineering and business intelligence capabilities our Accounting organization runs on. In this unique company, technology, and moment in history, your work will be critical to ensuring accurate financial reporting, streamlining accounting processes, and supporting financial operations as we deploy safe, frontier AI at scale to the world.</p> <p>You'll partner closely with the Accounting organization to build the data foundation that turns financial and operational data into reliable, self-serve insight and automated processes. That means owning the data models and orchestration beneath accounting analytics, designing the dashboards and data applications stakeholders rely on day to day, and partnering across Data Engineering, Data Science, and the broader Finance organization to make sure every number is one the team can trust. Increasingly, it also means defining the future of AI-powered accounting automation; finding where AI can take on work that is manual today and reshape how the function operates.</p> <p>This is a foundational, hands-on role at the intersection of accounting, analytics, and business intelligence. You'll establish the durable, scalable systems the fast-growing function depends on, bringing the rigor of a culture of excellence to a function still being built from the ground up, and taking projects end to end, from an ambiguous question to a trusted, scalable system.</p> <h2><strong>Key responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Design, build, and maintain data models and orchestration pipelines (dbt, Airflow) that power analytics, reporting, and downstream financial workflows</li> <li>Develop dashboards, visualizations, and data applications that give stakeholders self-serve access to their data</li> <li>Translate stakeholders' business questions into well-defined metrics and tools, and turn the resulting analysis into clear recommendations</li> <li>Build analytics that support financial reporting, the close process, reconciliations, and scenario analysis</li> <li>Define the future of AI-powered accounting automation in partnership with stakeholders, streamlining workflows and reducing manual effort</li> <li>Champion data quality, testing, and documentation across the data stack</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Minimum qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Proficiency in SQL and Python (or another object-oriented programming language)</li> <li>Experience with data modeling and orchestration tools (e.g., dbt and Airflow)</li> <li>Experience with data visualization and business intelligence tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Hex, Streamlit)</li> <li>Experience designing self-serve analytics experiences for non-technical stakeholders</li> <li>A track record of partnering closely with Finance or Accounting teams to drive business and financial outcomes, turning open questions and data into clear, insightful analysis</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience using AI to improve or automate analytical processes</li> <li>Experience building data applications</li> <li>Experience with cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP) and their cost structures</li> <li>Experience modeling financial impact, including forecasting and scenario analysis</li> <li>A bias for action and urgency, not letting perfect be the enemy of effective</li> <li>A strong disposition to thrive in ambiguity, taking initiative to create clarity and forward progress</li> <li>A deep curiosity and energy for pulling the thread on hard questions</li> <li>A passion for Anthropic's mission of building safe, beneficial AI</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.&nbsp;</p> <p>For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.</p></div><div class="title">Annual Salary:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$270,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$345,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Logistics</strong></h2> <p><strong>Minimum education: </strong>Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience</p> <p><strong>Required field of study:&nbsp;</strong>A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience</p> <p><strong>Minimum years of experience: </strong>Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position</p> <p><strong>Location-based hybrid policy:</strong> Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Visa sponsorship:</strong>&nbsp;We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.</p> <p><strong>We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.</strong> Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.&nbsp; Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.<br><br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Your safety matters to us.</strong> To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from&nbsp;@anthropic.com&nbsp;email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit&nbsp;<u data-stringify-type="underline"><a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="http://anthropic.com/careers" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://anthropic.com/careers" data-sk="tooltip_parent" data-remove-tab-index="true">anthropic.com/careers</a></u>&nbsp;directly for confirmed position openings.</p> <h2><strong>How we're different</strong></h2> <p>We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.</p> <p>The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI &amp; Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.</p> <h2><strong>Come work with us!</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. <strong data-stringify-type="bold">Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:</strong>&nbsp;Learn about&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" data-sk="tooltip_parent">our policy</a> for using AI in our application process.</p></div>

jobs.title: Management Consultant - Data Engineer
jobs.description: Introduction A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact.
